title: Three towns: a systematic typo and an ambiguous slip
blurb: 25 rows, 10 practices, 3 real towns. Practice P01 misspells Abingdon as 'abington' on every one of its rows, and 'bethan' is exactly two edits from both Bethel and Dothan. Watch SMC commit to the misspelling, rejuvenation question it, reweighting punish the particles that kept it, and resampling copy the fix.

Weights do not change: this is an MCMC move that leaves the target invariant.
